# Single Cell Proteomics Data Package

![](sticker/sticker.png)

The `scpdata` package contains standardized and annotated single-cell
proteomics data.

[![Project Status: Active – The project has reached a stable, usable
state and is being actively
developed.](https://www.repostatus.org/badges/latest/active.svg)](https://www.repostatus.org/#active)

# Installation instruction

To install the stable version from Bioconductor:

`if`` ``(``!`[`requireNamespace`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/ns-load.html)`(``"BiocManager"``)``)`` `` `[`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(``"BiocManager"``)`` ``BiocManager``::`[`install`](https://bioconductor.github.io/BiocManager/reference/install.html)`(``"scpdata"``)`

To install the development version from GitHub:

`BiocManager``::`[`install`](https://bioconductor.github.io/BiocManager/reference/install.html)`(``"UCLouvain-CBIO/scpdata"``)`

# Loading a data set

The available datasets can be accessed through `ExperimentHub`. Use
[`scpdata()`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/scpdata.md)
to display the table with available datasets.

[`library`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/library.html)`(`[`scpdata`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/)`)`` `[`scpdata`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/scpdata.md)`(``)`

You can either use the `ExperimentHub` interface or use the functions
provided `scpdata` to retrieve the data set of interest.

## Loading data using the `ExperimentHub` interface

You first need to set up a connection with `ExperimentHub`. You can
browse and query the database to look up a data set of interest (see
[`?ExperimentHub`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/ExperimentHub/man/ExperimentHub-class.html)
for more information).

`eh`` ``<-`` `[`ExperimentHub`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/ExperimentHub/man/ExperimentHub-class.html)`(``)`` ``query``(``eh``, ``"scpdata"``)`

Suppose you are interested in the `specht2019v2` data set, you can
retrieve the data using the corresponding `ExperimentHub` ID. In this
case the ID is `EH3899`.

`scp`` ``<-`` ``eh``[[``"EH3899"``]``]`

## Loading data using the `scpdata` functions

`scpdata` exports a function for each of the data sets. Retrieving the
`specht2019v2` is performed by simply running the
[`specht2019v2()`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/specht2019v2.md)
function.

`scp`` ``<-`` `[`specht2019v2`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/specht2019v2.md)`(``)`

The documentation of each function contains information about its
corresponding data set. The information includes a description of the
data content, the acquisition protocol, the data collection procedure,
and some associated references and data sources.

`?``specht2019v2`

# Available data

We collected the associated data that usually contains 3 levels of :

- **PSM data** is the data obtained after running feature identification
  and quantification from the raw data. PSM stands for peptide to
  spectrum match. The rows in the data are PSMs and columns are samples.
- **Peptide data** is the expression data where rows are peptides and
  columns are samples.
- **Protein data** is the expression data where rows are proteins and
  columns are samples.

Please refer to the documentation and original papers for a thorough
description of the data processing.

# Contributing to `scpdata`

Suggestions and bug reports are warmly welcome! You can submit them by
creating an issue on the the [`scpdata` GitHub
repository](https://github.com/UCLouvain-CBIO/scpdata/issues).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ai2025a`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/ai2025a.md)
  : Ai et al., Cardiomyocytes Single Cell Proteomics, MCP (2025)
- [`brunner2022`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/brunner2022.md)
  : Brunner et al. 2022 (Mol. Syst. Biol.): cell cycle state study
- [`cong2020AC`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/cong2020AC.md)
  : Cong et al. 2020 (Ana. Chem.): HeLa single cells
- [`derks2022`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/derks2022.md)
  : Derks et al. 2022 - plexDIA (Nat. Biotechnol.): PDAC vs melanoma
  cells vs monocytes
- [`dou2019_boosting`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/dou2019_boosting.md)
  : Dou et al. 2019 (Anal. Chem.): testing boosting ratios
- [`dou2019_lysates`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/dou2019_lysates.md)
  : Dou et al. 2019 (Anal. Chem.): HeLa lysates
- [`dou2019_mouse`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/dou2019_mouse.md)
  : Dou et al. 2019 (Anal. Chem.): murine cell lines
- [`gregoire2023_mixCTRL`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/gregoire2023_mixCTRL.md)
  : Grégoire et al. 2023 - mixCTRL (arXiv): benchmark using
  monocytes/macrophages
- [`guise2024`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/guise2024.md)
  : Guise et al. 2020 (Cell Rep.): postmortem ALS spinal moto neurons
- [`hu2023_K562`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/hu2023_K562.md)
  : Hu et al, 2023 (The Journal of Physical Chemistry B): Correlated
  protein modules
- [`khan2023`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/khan2023.md)
  : Khan et al, 2023 (biorRxiv): Epithelial–Mesenchymal Transition
- [`krull2024`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/krull2024.md)
  : Krull et al, 2024 (Nature Communications): IFN-\\\gamma\\ response
- [`leduc2022()`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/leduc2022.md)
  : Deprecated leduc2022 dataset
- [`leduc2022_pSCoPE`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/leduc2022_pSCoPE.md)
  : Leduc et al. 2022 - pSCoPE (biorRxiv): melanoma cells vs monocytes
- [`leduc2022_plexDIA`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/leduc2022_plexDIA.md)
  : Leduc et al. 2022 - plexDIA (biorRxiv): melanoma cells
- [`leduc2025`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/leduc2025.md)
  : Leduc et al, 2025 (bioRxiv): Principles of protein abundance
  regulation across single cells in a mammalian tissue
- [`liang2020_hela`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/liang2020_hela.md)
  : Liang et al. 2020 (Anal. Chem.): HeLa cells (MaxQuant preprocessing)
- [`petrosius2023_AstralAML`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/petrosius2023_AstralAML.md)
  : Petrosius et al. 2023 (bioRxiv): AML hierarchy on Astral.
- [`petrosius2023_mES`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/petrosius2023_mES.md)
  : Petrosius et al, 2023 (Nat. Comm.): Mouse embryonic stem cell (mESC)
  in different culture conditions
- [`schoof2021`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/schoof2021.md)
  : Schoof et al. 2021 (Nat. Comm.): acute myeloid leukemia
  differentiation
- [`scpdata()`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/scpdata.md)
  : Single-Cell Proteomics Data Package
- [`specht2019v2`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/specht2019v2.md)
  : Specht et al. 2019 - SCoPE2 (biorRxiv): macrophages vs monocytes
  (version 2)
- [`specht2019v3`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/specht2019v3.md)
  : Specht et al. 2019 - SCoPE2 (biorRxiv): macrophages vs monocytes
  (version 3)
- [`williams2020_lfq`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/williams2020_lfq.md)
  : Williams et al. 2020 (Anal. Chem.): MCF10A cell line
- [`williams2020_tmt`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/williams2020_tmt.md)
  : Williams et al. 2020 (Anal. Chem.): 3 AML cell line
- [`woo2022_lung`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/woo2022_lung.md)
  : Woo et al. 2022 (Cell Syst.): 26 primary human lung cells
- [`woo2022_macrophage`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/woo2022_macrophage.md)
  : Woo et al. 2022 (Cell Syst.): LPS-treated macrophages
- [`wu2026`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/wu2026.md)
  : Wu et al., 2026 (Nature Biotechnology): single-cell proteomic
  landscape of the developing human brain
- [`zhu2018MCP`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/zhu2018MCP.md)
  : Zhu et al. 2018 (Mol. Cel. Prot.): rat brain laser dissections
- [`zhu2018NC_hela`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/zhu2018NC_hela.md)
  : Zhu et al. 2018 (Nat. Comm.): HeLa titration
- [`zhu2018NC_islets`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/zhu2018NC_islets.md)
  : Zhu et al. 2018 (Nat. Comm.): human pancreatic islets
- [`zhu2018NC_lysates`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/zhu2018NC_lysates.md)
  : Zhu et al. 2018 (Nat. Comm.): HeLa lysates
- [`zhu2019EL`](https://UCLouvain-CBIO.github.io/scpdata/reference/zhu2019EL.md)
  : Zhu et al. 2019 (eLife): chicken utricle cells
